name: First Flight
design_intent: TUTORIAL 1 of 4 (owner 2026-07-16: 'help explain the controls'). Lesson: HOLD BOOST TO FLY. One wide safe trampoline floor (no void anywhere — a failed flight lands back on the floor, zero stakes), goal ring floating 540px above the floor top at the far end. 540 > 270 (trampoline apex) so a plain bounce cannot reach it — the ONLY way in is holding boost (climb 760 px/s => ~0.8s of thrust after a bounce). Fuel is a non-issue (tank = 3.5s ~ 2660px of flight; the whole course is one 1600px drift + one 540px climb). The ring sits over solid floor so the miss case is a soft landing, never a death. Teaching is carried by the persistent HUD hint line + the geometry making flight the only verb that works.
hint: HOLD  A / SPACE  —  FLY UP TO THE RING
